boundary: These two checks observe process response and read access only. Configuration facts are not health probes or proof of operational success.
probeError: This read did not return the expected response. Inspect its owning evidence, then retry.
policyError: Policy facts could not be refreshed. Retained facts are from the last successful read.
policyUnavailable: Policy facts are unavailable. Retry this read without changing configuration.
localAuthority: This local session uses the development authorization ceiling. Display identity does not grant capabilities; review server-verified access in IAM.
productionAuthority: Display identity is not authorization. The server verifies the stable principal and current roles.
copyBoundary: The summary excludes display identity, credentials, endpoint values and raw errors. Pending probes are excluded.
copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable. No diagnostic data was copied.
